license_required.quote: an individual shall be licensed by the Board before the individual may practice registered nursing in this State

issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the State Board of Nursing.

name.quote: "Board" means the State Board of Nursing.

type.quote: "Board" means the State Board of Nursing.

umbrella_agency.quote: "Department" means the Maryland Department of Health.

moral_character_required.quote: An applicant for a license under this section shall be of good moral character.

degree_required.value: Diploma or degree from a registered nursing education program (RN) or diploma from a licensed practical nursing education program (LPN)
degree_required.quote: An applicant for a license to practice registered nursing shall complete satisfactorily and meet all requirements for a diploma or degree from: (1) A registered nursing education program approved by the Board

accrediting_body.quote: A registered nursing education program approved by the Board

exams.name: NCLEX (National Council Licensure Examination)
exams.notes: Developed by the National Council of State Boards of Nursing and administered at a testing site approved by the National Council
exams.quote: the applicant shall pass an examination developed by the National Council of State Boards of Nursing and administered at a testing site approved by the National Council.

exams.name: Board-approved national examination for advanced practice registered nurses
exams.quote: An applicant qualifies for certification as an advanced practice registered nurse only if the applicant passes a Board–approved national examination for advanced practice registered nurses.

interval_years.quote: A license expires on the 28th day of the birth month of the licensee and may not be renewed for a term longer than 2 years.

required.quote: A minimum number of continuing education units as required by regulations adopted by the Board.

period_years.quote: may not be renewed for a term longer than 2 years

available.quote: the Board may issue a license by endorsement and waive any appropriate examination requirement of this title for an applicant who has an active unencumbered license to practice registered nursing or licensed practical nursing in any other state or country.

requirements.value: Applicant must have active unencumbered license in another state or country, meet educational qualifications required by Maryland at time of graduation, have passed a substantially equivalent examination, and meet all other qualifications required by Maryland law.
requirements.quote: The Board may issue a license by endorsement under this section only if the applicant ... Provides adequate evidence that: (i) At the time the applicant graduated from a nursing education program approved in the other state or country, the applicant met the educational qualifications then required by the laws of this State

regulatory_model.quote: an individual shall be licensed by the Board before the individual may practice registered nursing in this State.

credential_type.quote: "License" means, unless the context requires otherwise, a license issued by the Board to practice: (1) Registered nursing; (2) Licensed practical nursing; or (3) Advanced practice registered nursing.

is_mandatory.quote: an individual may not practice, attempt to practice, or offer to practice registered nursing, advanced practice registered nursing, or licensed practical nursing in this State unless licensed by the Board

title_protection.quote: Unless authorized to practice registered nursing under this title, an individual may not use the words or terms "registered nurse", the abbreviations "R.N.", or any other title, symbol, abbreviation, sign, card, device, or other representation with the intent to represent that the individual practices registered nursing.

scope_protection.quote: an individual may not practice, attempt to practice, or offer to practice registered nursing, advanced practice registered nursing, or licensed practical nursing in this State unless licensed by the Board to practice registered nursing, advanced practice registered nursing, or licensed practical nursing, respectively.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraudulently or deceptively obtaining or attempting to obtain a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraudulently or deceptively obtains or attempts to obtain a license for the applicant or for another

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraudulently or deceptively using a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraudulently or deceptively uses a license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disciplined by a licensing or disciplinary authority in this or another state or country for an act that would be grounds for discipline here
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is disciplined by a licensing, military, or disciplinary authority in this State or in any other state or country or convicted or disciplined by a court in this State or in any other state or country for an act that would be grounds for disciplinary action under the Board's disciplinary statutes

disciplinary_grounds.description: Convicted of or pleading guilty or nolo contendere to a felony or crime involving moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is convicted of or pleads guilty or nolo contendere to a felony or to a crime involving moral turpitude, whether or not any appeal or other proceeding is pending to have the conviction or plea set aside

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully filing false reports or records, giving false information in employment applications, or failing to file required health records
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully and knowingly: (i) Files a false report or record of an individual under the licensee's care; (ii) Gives any false or misleading information about a material matter in an employment application

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly performing acts determined by the Board to exceed the authorized scope of practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly does any act that has been determined by the Board, in its rules and regulations, to exceed the scope of practice authorized to the individual under this title

disciplinary_grounds.description: Providing professional services while under the influence of alcohol or using narcotics or controlled substances in excess of therapeutic amounts
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Provides professional services while: (i) Under the influence of alcohol; or (ii) Using any narcotic or controlled dangerous substance, as defined in § 5–101 of the Criminal Law Article, or other drug that is in excess of therapeutic amounts or without valid medical indication

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acting inconsistently with generally accepted professional standards in the practice of registered or licensed practical nursing
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Does an act that is inconsistent with generally accepted professional standards in the practice of registered nursing or licensed practical nursing

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being grossly negligent in the practice of registered or licensed practical nursing
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is grossly negligent in the practice of registered nursing or licensed practical nursing

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any provision of this title
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated any provision of this title

disciplinary_grounds.description: Submitting a false statement to collect a fee
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Submits a false statement to collect a fee

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being physically or mentally incompetent
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is physically or mentally incompetent

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly failing to report suspected child abuse
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly fails to report suspected child abuse in violation of § 5–704 of the Family Law Article

disciplinary_grounds.description: Refusing or discriminating against an individual in providing professional services because the individual is HIV positive
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Refuses, withholds from, denies, or discriminates against an individual with regard to the provision of professional services for which the licensee is licensed and qualified to render because the individual is HIV positive

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to comply with CDC guidelines on universal precautions except in emergency life-threatening situations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Except in an emergency life–threatening situation where it is not feasible or practicable, fails to comply with the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention's guidelines on universal precautions

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a substance use disorder
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has a substance use disorder

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being addicted to or habitually abusing narcotics or controlled dangerous substances
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is addicted to, or habitually abuses, any narcotic or controlled dangerous substance as defined in § 5–101 of the Criminal Law Article

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to cooperate with a lawful investigation conducted by the Board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fails to cooperate with a lawful investigation conducted by the Board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being expelled from the safe practice program for failure to comply with program conditions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is expelled from the safe practice program established pursuant to § 8–208 of this title for failure to comply with the conditions of the program

disciplinary_grounds.description: Delegating nursing acts to an individual known to lack the ability or knowledge to perform them
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Delegates nursing acts or responsibilities to an individual that the applicant or licensee knows or has reason to know lacks the ability or knowledge to perform

disciplinary_grounds.description: Delegating to an unlicensed individual nursing acts known to be performable only by licensed nurses
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Delegates to an unlicensed individual nursing acts or responsibilities the applicant or licensee knows or has reason to know are to be performed only by a registered nurse or licensed practical nurse

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to properly supervise individuals to whom nursing acts have been delegated
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fails to properly supervise individuals to whom nursing acts or responsibilities have been delegated

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in conduct that violates the professional code of ethics
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engages in conduct that violates the professional code of ethics

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being professionally incompetent
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is professionally incompetent

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing registered or licensed practical nursing without a license, including on an expired or lapsed license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practices registered nursing or licensed practical nursing without a license before obtaining or renewing a license, including any period when practicing registered nursing or licensed practical nursing on an expired license or a lapsed license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating regulations adopted by the Board or an order from the Board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violates regulations adopted by the Board or an order from the Board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing an act beyond the licensee's knowledge and skills
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performs an act that is beyond the licensee's knowledge and skills

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to submit to a criminal history records check as required
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fails to submit to a criminal history records check in accordance with § 8–303 of this subtitle

disciplinary_grounds.description: Misappropriating the property of a patient or a facility
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has misappropriated the property of a patient or a facility

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to comply with opioid prescribing limits under § 1-223
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fails to comply with § 1–223 of this article.

definition_quote.value: "Practice registered nursing" means the performance of acts requiring substantial specialized knowledge, judgment, and skill based on the biological, physiological, behavioral, or sociological sciences as the basis for assessment, nursing diagnosis, planning, implementation, and evaluation of the practice of nursing in order to: (i) Maintain health; (ii) Prevent illness; or (iii) Care for or rehabilitate the ill, injured, or infirm.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice registered nursing" means the performance of acts requiring substantial specialized knowledge, judgment, and skill based on the biological, physiological, behavioral, or sociological sciences as the basis for assessment, nursing diagnosis, planning, implementation, and evaluation of the practice of nursing

value: Supervision, delegation, and evaluation of nursing practice
Execution of therapeutic regimen, including administration of medication and treatment
Independent nursing functions and delegated medical functions
Performance of additional acts authorized by the Board
methods_authorized.quote: "practice registered nursing" includes: (i) Administration; (ii) Teaching; (iii) Counseling; (iv) Supervision, delegation, and evaluation of nursing practice; (v) Execution of therapeutic regimen, including the administration of medication and treatment; (vi) Independent nursing functions and delegated medical functions; and (vii) Performance of additional acts authorized by the Board

drug_authority.value: Nurse practitioners and nurse midwives may prescribe drugs including controlled substances on Schedules II-V; nurse anesthetists may prescribe drugs including controlled dangerous substances in connection with anesthesia services (up to 10-day supply); clinical nurse specialists may prescribe drugs under Board regulations.
drug_authority.quote: Prescribe drugs as provided under § 8–508 of this title

value: Advanced Practice Registered Nurse (APRN) - Nurse Practitioner
Advanced Practice Registered Nurse (APRN) - Nurse Anesthetist
Advanced Practice Registered Nurse (APRN) - Nurse Midwife
Advanced Practice Registered Nurse (APRN) - Clinical Nurse Specialist
license_tiers.quote: "License" means, unless the context requires otherwise, a license issued by the Board to practice: (1) Registered nursing; (2) Licensed practical nursing; or (3) Advanced practice registered nursing.

aprn_role_categories.quote: Is certified by the Board to practice as: (i) A nurse practitioner; (ii) A nurse anesthetist; (iii) A nurse midwife; or (iv) A clinical nurse specialist.

value: Licensed health professional who is not a licensed practical nurse
lpn_supervision_requirements.quote: a licensed practical nurse may practice licensed practical nursing only in a team relationship with at least one licensed health professional who is not a licensed practical nurse.

collaborative_practice_agreement_require.quote: This section may not be construed to require a written collaboration agreement between a nurse anesthetist and an anesthesiologist, a physician, or a dentist.

full_independent_practice_available.quote: "Practice as a registered nurse practitioner" means to independently: (1) Perform an act under subsection (o) of this section; (2) Conduct a comprehensive physical assessment of an individual; (3) Establish a medical diagnosis for common chronic stable or short–term health problems

full_independent_practice_experience_hou.quote: An applicant for initial certification as a registered nurse practitioner who has not been certified by the Board or any other board of nursing shall identify on the application for certification a mentor who will consult and collaborate with the applicant for 18 months beginning on the date the application for certification is received by the Board.

prescriptive_authority_certificate_requi.quote: "Nurse practitioner" means a registered nurse who is: (i) Certified as a nurse practitioner; and (ii) Authorized to prescribe drugs under regulations adopted by the Board.

controlled_substance_schedule_authority.quote: The prescribing of controlled substances on Schedules II, III, IV, and V commonly used in the practice of nurse midwifery

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: On treatment for pain, a health care provider shall prescribe the lowest effective dose of an opioid and a quantity no greater than needed for the expected duration of pain, unless treating substance-related disorder, cancer pain, end-of-life/hospice/palliative care, or chronic pain.
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: On treatment for pain, a health care provider, based on the clinical judgment of the health care provider, shall prescribe: (1) The lowest effective dose of an opioid; and (2) A quantity that is no greater than the quantity needed for the expected duration of pain severe enough to require an opioid

nurse_aide_registry_maintained.quote: To maintain a nurse aide registry that complies with federal law

medication_assistant_certification_avail.quote: "Certified medication technician" means an individual who: (1) Has completed a Board–approved medication technician training program; (2) Is certified by the Board as a medication technician

delegation_to_unlicensed_personnel_autho.quote: This section does not preclude a registered nurse or licensed practical nurse from delegating a nursing or other technical task to an unlicensed individual if acceptance of delegated nursing or other technical tasks does not become a routine part of the unlicensed individual's job duties.

employer_mandatory_reporting_required.quote: If a nursing administrator, a registered nurse, an advanced practice registered nurse, a licensed practical nurse, or a certified nursing assistant knows of an action or condition that might be grounds for action under § 8–316 or Subtitle 6A of this title, the nursing administrator, registered nurse, advanced practice registered nurse, licensed practical nurse, or certified nursing assistant shall report the action or condition to the Board

whistleblower_protection_for_delegation_.quote: Subject to § 1-503 of this subtitle, an employer may not take or refuse to take any personnel action as reprisal against an employee because the employee: ... (3) Objects to or refuses to participate in any activity, policy, or practice in violation of a law, rule, or regulation.

nurse_licensure_compact_member.quote: The Nurse Licensure Compact is hereby enacted and entered into with all other jurisdictions that legally join in the Compact

multistate_license_option_available.quote: "Single–state license" means a nurse license issued by a party state that authorizes practice only within the issuing state and does not include a multistate licensure privilege to practice in any other party state.

impaired_nurse_alternative_program_avail.quote: There is a Safe Practice Committee in the Board.

nurse_practitioner_transition_to_practic.quote: An applicant for initial certification as a registered nurse practitioner who has not been certified by the Board or any other board of nursing shall identify on the application for certification a mentor who will consult and collaborate with the applicant for 18 months beginning on the date the application for certification is received by the Board.

crna_physician_supervision_model.quote: An anesthesiologist, a licensed physician, or a dentist shall be physically available to the nurse anesthetist for consultation at all times during the administration of, and recovery from, anesthesia

aprn_formulary_or_protocol_required.quote: A nurse practitioner or midwife may personally prepare and dispense a starter dosage of any drug the nurse practitioner or midwife is authorized to prescribe to a patient

implicit_bias_training_required_in_curri.quote: An applicant for the renewal of a license or certificate issued by a health occupations board under this article shall attest in the application that the applicant has completed an implicit bias training program approved by the Cultural and Linguistic Health Care Professional Competency Program

military_education_credit_required.quote: Each unit shall credit any training and education provided by the military and completed by a service member toward any training or education requirements for licensure if the training or education is determined by the unit to be: (1) substantially equivalent to the training or education required by the unit
military_education_credit_required.citation: UMBRELLA / Title 2.5 - Service Members, Veterans, and Military Spouses
